figma.description: Remote Figma MCP. Use Claude Code (not Cursor) — Cursor's OAuth app only accepts cursor:// redirects, not mcporter's localhost callback.

figma-desktop.description: Local Figma desktop Dev Mode MCP (no OAuth). Enable in Figma app → Dev Mode → MCP.

slack-mcp.description: Official Slack MCP (Cursor partner client id). Slack does not support dynamic client registration.

peekaboo.description: macOS screen capture + UI automation MCP (stdio). No --help flag — starts Swift server immediately. Needs Screen Recording + Accessibility.
